description.value: The Canada Games Aquatic Centre is a municipal swimming facility in Kamloops operated by the City of Kamloops. It offers swimming alongside amenities including a hot tub, sauna, and steam room, making it a notable stop for touring cyclists looking to recover after a long day on the road. It is wheelchair accessible and located on McGill Road near the Thompson Rivers University campus.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific OSM-listed URL returned a '404 Page not found' on the City of Kamloops website, so no facility-specific page content was available; all amenity evidence must come from OSM tags. OSM tags confirm hot_tub=yes, sauna=yes, steam_room=yes, and wheelchair=yes, indicating a well-equipped public aquatic centre. No evidence exists in either the OSM tags or the retrieved website navigation text for bike parking, washrooms, showers, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so these are all marked null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: The specific OSM-listed website URL (https://www.kamloops.ca/recreation-culture/facility-hours-rates/canada-games-aquatic-centre) returned a 404 'Page not found' error. The page may have been reorganized; the City of Kamloops aquatics section is accessible via the site navigation but the direct URL is broken. Contact info and amenities could not be confirmed from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible municipal aquatic centre with confirmed OSM presence and an operational city website; facility appears open and would be useful to touring cyclists seeking recovery amenities.

wow_evidence: Municipal pool with hot tub, sauna, steam room; after-ride band.
blurb: Kamloops' aquatic centre near TRU: pool, hot tub, sauna, and steam room.
